function.arguments:
{"command": "cat <<'EOF' > create_figure.py
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# Create a 2x2 grid of subplots sharing x and y axes
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, sharex=True, sharey=True)

# Define the points to plot
x = [1, 2, 3]
y = [1, 4, 9]

# Plot in each subplot with different markers
# Top-left: star ('*')
axes[0, 0].plot(x, y, marker='*', markersize=100)

# Top-right: pentagon ('p')
axes[0, 1].plot(x, y, marker='p', markersize=100)

# Bottom-left: hexagon ('h')
axes[1, 0].plot(x, y, marker='h', markersize=100)

# Bottom-right: diamond ('D')
axes[1, 1].plot(x, y, marker='D', markersize=100)

# Set labels for better readability
axes[0, 0].set_title('Top-Left: Star')
axes[0, 1].set_title('Top-Right: Pentagon')
axes[1, 0].set_title('Bottom-Left: Hexagon')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Bottom-Right: Diamond')

# Add a main title
fig.suptitle('2x2 Grid with Different Markers')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('figure.png', dpi=100, bbox_inches='tight')

print("Figure saved as figure.png")
EOF
"}
